source.title: Service Insights on MealConnect (SIMC) Neighbor Intake Form- TEFAP

questions.label: First Name
questions.note: Printed as "a. First Name"; letters and the two-digit data-entry codes after each choice are left out.

questions.label: Last Name
Zip code where you currently live
No fixed address
questions.note: A lone box under the ZIP line; ticked when the applicant has no fixed address.

questions.label: Email Address (OPTIONAL)
Ok to contact*
questions.note: Permission to be contacted by email.

questions.label: Phone Number (OPTIONAL)
Ok to contact*
questions.note: Permission to be contacted by phone.

questions.label: What method of communication do you prefer? (OPTIONAL)
questions.note: Contact preference; not in the profile.

questions.label: How many other people live in your household (do not include yourself)?
questions.note: Household size minus the applicant; no saved field holds that number.

questions.label: Authorized Representative: Is there someone else who may pick up food for you? (OPTIONAL) Name
questions.note: Someone else who may pick up food; not in the profile. The question and its "Name:" box label are joined.

questions.label: Authorized Representative: Is there someone else who may pick up food for you? (OPTIONAL) Phone Number
questions.note: The authorized representative's phone, not the applicant's. The question and its "Phone Number:" box label are joined.

questions.label: Does anyone in your household currently receive SNAP (Oregon Trail/EBT card or food stamps)?
options: Don’t Know/ Prefer not to answer
questions.note: Asks whether anyone already receives SNAP, not whether the applicant is applying.

questions.label: Does anyone in your household currently receive benefits through any of the following government programs? (Select all that apply) (OPTIONAL)
options: Don’t Know/ Prefer not to answer
questions.note: Benefits already received; the profile only knows what the applicant is applying for.

questions.label: Is your household income at or below 300% of the federal poverty levels, OR are you currently participating in SNAP (food stamps program), TANF, SSI, or LIHEAP?
questions.note: Income at or below 300% of poverty for the household size, or program participation; one fixed income rule cannot decide it.

questions.label: Date of Birth (mm/dd/yyyy) or Age
questions.note: Printed as __/__/____ (mm/dd/yyyy) with "or Age: ____" beside it.

questions.label: What gender do you identify as? (Select one)
options: Don’t Know/ Prefer not to answer
questions.note: Gender identity; not in the profile.

questions.label: What race or ethnicity do you identify as? (Select all that apply)
options: Native Hawaiian or other Pacific Islander
Don’t know/ Prefer not to answer
questions.note: Race or ethnicity; not in the profile.

questions.label: Household Members: First Name (OPTIONAL)
questions.note: household member grid (8 rows, not including the applicant)

questions.label: Household Members: Last Name (OPTIONAL)
questions.note: household member grid

questions.label: Household Members: Date of Birth or Age (REQUIRED)
questions.note: household member grid

questions.label: Household Members: Gender Identity (OPTIONAL)
questions.note: household member grid

questions.label: Household Members: Race/Ethnicity (OPTIONAL)
questions.note: household member grid

questions.label: What language(s) are spoken in your household? (Select all that apply)
questions.note: Languages spoken; not in the profile.

questions.label: What is your living situation today?
options: I have a steady place to live
I have a place to live today, but I am worried about losing it in the future
I do not have a steady place to live
Don’t know/ Prefer not to answer
questions.note: Three housing situations plus prefer not to answer; no yes/no fact picks among them.

questions.label: Has anyone in your household, including yourself, served on active duty in the U.S. Armed Forces? Active duty includes serving in the U.S. Armed Forces as well as activation from the Reserves or National Guard.
options: Yes, on active duty in the past, but not now
No, never on active duty except for initial/basic training
No, never served in the U.S. Armed Forces
Don’t know/ Prefer not to answer
questions.note: The Yes choices split past from current active duty; the household veteran fact cannot pick between them.
